verdict.rationale: Databricks SQL documents a first-party rule mechanism: alerts that monitor query results, evaluate conditions, and deliver notifications automatically. Auto Loader adds arrival-driven processing of new files. The evidence only shows notifications as the triggered action, and it does not show general event-based triggers or rule-to-arbitrary-action automation. Missing for 10: documented event-trigger types (e.g., table updates or file arrival tied to user rules), actions beyond notifications, rule-configuration depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Monitor query results, evaluate conditions, and deliver notifications automatically.
Incrementally and efficiently process new data files as they arrive in cloud storage.
